Iris: quick notenoticed a small spike in duplicate owner rows after the sandbox connector backfill. found ~52 accounts.
Tom: ack. what's the safest path? pause backfill and run merge?
Iris: yes. plan: pause for 45m, run idempotent merge that keeps newest owner_id by source_ts, emit audit event. sample detection query used: SELECT account_id FROM owners GROUP BY account_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1;
Priya: please also tag affected accounts with 'owner-hygiene:in-progress' and suppress renewal triggers for 72h. CS team can't get alert storms.
Tom: also queue a healthscore single-account re-eval post-merge to avoid false renewal flags.
PlaybookBot: created dry-run rule 'owner-hygiene-suppress' scheduled 2026-04-02T18:00Z against last 14d; estimated matches: 52. Report in #customer-success in 3m.
CSOpsBot: paused nightly backfill. Merge dry-run started. Posting results when complete.
Iris: drafting CSM note now; will paste here for sign-off.
Priya: thanks — prefer short template: "We merged duplicate owner records due to a data backfill. No action needed. We've suppressed automated renewal nudges for 72 hours while we validate."
Iris: posted. assigning: Tom -> merge job + re-eval; Priya -> CSM outreach; Iris -> monitor & flip playbook active after CS OK.
Tom: starting merge. will update on success/fail. :thumbsup:
